newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Amen Bank takes Tunis bourse index down.
newsitem.headline: Amen Bank takes Tunis bourse index down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 2.57 percent on the fall of Amen Bank by 22.96 percent, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 511.90 points from 525.42 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 1.05 million dinars against 1.02 million dinars over the previous session.

Amen Bank dropped 11.02 dinars to 36.96 dinars. Brokers said the drop was the second phase of the share's adjustment to computerised trading. Under the previous system, in which share prices were displayed on a blackboard, price movements were much less transparent.
On March 17, it lost 10.52 dinars when traded at first on the computerised system with its greater transparency.
"It looks like Amen Bank share has reached its normal price with this second adjustment," a broker said.
Airliner Tunis Air fell 0.58 dinar to 23.1. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was down 0.43 dinar to 14.09 dinars. Investment fund Placement de Tunisie edged lower 0.42 dinar to 13.7.
UIB bank slid 0.4 dinar to 13.22 dinars.
STB bank gained 0.8 dinar to 20 dinars. Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing was up 0.4 dinar to 34.5. Chemical firm SPCD rose 0.32 dinar to 38 dinars. ($1= 1.07 dinar)
